subject: Transition from retainer to committed capacity & billing contact update
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@horizonai.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Horizon AI Billing <payments@horizonai.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Questions about billing for renewal + capacity commit

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to convert our monthly retainer into a 12-month committed capacity agreement tied to the renewal (deal D-7832). Before we finalize, finance has a few practical asks so invoicing can flow cleanly:

- We'll submit a PO; please confirm the exact payee/entity name you need on the PO.
- Our procurement prefers Net30 terms for committed capacity — can Redwood accept Net30 for this contract?
- Please confirm the billing contact email (we'd like to switch to finance@horizonai.com for invoices).
- We also need a current W-9 for Redwood to attach to our vendor file.

I've attached a draft PO and our vendor intake form to this email.

Attachments: Horizon_PO_7832.pdf (application/pdf), Horizon_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate a quick confirmation so procurement can route this today.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Procurement, Horizon AI
lina@horizonai.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions about billing for renewal + capacity commit

Lina — thanks for the clear list. Happy to confirm next steps: 

1) Payee/legal entity: please put "Redwood Inference, Inc." exactly as the payee on the PO. If procurement needs the EIN, see below.
2) Net terms: we can accept Net30 for the committed capacity addendum on this deal (D-7832).
3) Billing contact: please route invoices to billing@redwood.com; we'll CC finance@horizonai.com as requested.
4) W-9: attaching our current W-9 and our AR instructions to speed processing.
5) Signed SOW: procurement should attach the signed SOW for the committed tier; we need that to finalize billing schedule.

Quick checklist for you to forward to procurement (we'll pick up the ticket on our side):
- Attach PO to HubSpot deal D-7832 (or send to billing@redwood.com)
- Confirm invoice frequency: monthly invoice for committed capacity (default) or upfront annual prepay — which do you prefer?
- Attach signed SOW to the PO or DocuSign envelope.

I've looped in Marissa from AR to confirm entity/EIN routing.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_AR_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf)

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Lina — copying the AR team here to confirm a few final billing details so we can provision the committed capacity without payment delays:

Can you confirm the following for our billing records:
- Legal payee exactly as it should appear on the invoice (Redwood listed as payee on PO is fine, we just need your payor name).
- Horizon AI invoicing entity (if different from parent) and EIN for tax reporting.
- Preferred invoice cadence: Monthly or Annual prepay (we typically invoice monthly unless requested otherwise).
- Any PO number we should reference on the invoice beyond the sample PO you attached.

If Horizon prefers Net30, we'll mark the AR terms accordingly. We'll also honor the billing contact switch once we receive the PO + signed SOW.

For ease, I'm attaching our AR instructions (wire details, remittance email, PO routing). If you prefer a consolidated invoice for multiple Redwood subscriptions to a single PO, call that out and we'll consolidate.
